origin: Cool Racing emerged from the vibrant Swiss amateur racing scene in the late 2000s, the brainchild of watchmaker and weekend racer, Anton Weber. Frustrated with the limitations of club racing and fueled by a passion to compete at a higher level, Weber pooled his resources and enlisted the help of his mechanically inclined friend, Klaus Richter, a local garage owner. Their early days were characterized by late nights in Richter's workshop, transforming salvaged parts into surprisingly competitive machines. A pivotal moment came during the 2012 Swiss National GT Championship, where against all odds, they secured a podium finish, proving their potential and attracting the attention of a small group of local sponsors.
philosophy: Cool Racing's philosophy centers on a pragmatic approach: maximizing performance with limited resources. Car development is iterative and data-driven, relying on Richter's practical ingenuity rather than cutting-edge simulation. The team culture emphasizes collaboration, resourcefulness, and a shared passion for racing, fostering a tight-knit environment where every member's contribution is valued.
achievements: 2012 Swiss National GT Championship: 3rd Place Overall
Multiple class wins in various regional endurance races
Consistent top-ten finishes in the European GT4 Series (Amateur Class)

teamPrincipal.name: Anton Weber
teamPrincipal.background: Weber's background in watchmaking instilled in him a meticulous attention to detail and a relentless pursuit of precision. He leads Cool Racing with a quiet determination, fostering a collaborative environment where passion and skill are paramount.

keyFigures.name: Klaus Richter
keyFigures.description: Richter is the team's mechanical wizard, possessing an uncanny ability to diagnose and solve problems with limited resources. His innovative solutions and practical experience are the backbone of Cool Racing's engineering efforts.

headquarters: Cool Racing operates from a modest workshop on the outskirts of Zurich. The facilities are basic but functional, equipped with the essential tools and equipment needed to maintain and develop their race cars.
fanBase: Cool Racing enjoys a loyal following among local motorsport enthusiasts in Switzerland, drawn to their underdog story and their commitment to grassroots racing. Their fans appreciate the team's approachable nature and their willingness to engage with the community.
